solver._status: DRAFT, proposed for the registration, not frozen, not run

_rationale.rtol_atol: tighter than legacy (1e-3, 1e-5) so the solver is not a source of disagreement between constructions
_rationale.t_max_t_tail: doubled from legacy with the tail kept at the final third, because lower Hill coefficients may settle more slowly; tail_range and final_derivative will show whether this suffices
_rationale.attempts: RK45 first; a larger RK45 budget only if the first hit its cap; an implicit stiff method only after a failure of any kind (2026-09-21 code review). Radau versus BDF to be chosen by benchmark before the freeze.

classifier._status: DRAFT, proposed for the registration, not frozen, not run

_rationale.fixed: tail range and final derivative thresholds from the 2026-09-21 code review, pending calibration against the solver's noise floor at rtol 1e-6
_rationale.oscillatory: tail range above 1e-4, inside [0, 1] up to the margin, and each half of the tail repeating the other's per-node maximum and minimum to within 5% of that node's range
_rationale.extension_horizons: 60 -> 120 -> 240, the tail kept at the final third of each horizon
